design.patch: the pull request reversed into the revert a reviewer would suggest

grammar.template: canonical Vitest test with the changed export and two literal slots

design.training_answer: the candidate test the untuned model scores highest, among inputs that expose the bug
design.selection: most proofs on validation and development bug PRs together; ties keep the untuned model, then the earlier candidate
design.expected_value: main's return at the model's input, measured with Vitest
design.acceptance: The chosen prover proves more bug PRs than the untuned model on validation, on the development cases and on the fresh test split, and proves no refactor on any of them.
